Rötschreck
Master: out-of-turn
Put this card on a vampire ***when an opposing minion attempts to
inflict aggravated damage*** on him or her, whether the damage would be
successfully inflicted or not. Combat ends. This vampire is tapped and
sent to torpor. This vampire does not untap as normal. During this
vampire's next untap phase, burn this card.

If you do not have the ability to inflict aggravated damage on me --
because you have 0 aggravated hand damage -- then you are unable to use
the card, by card text.
